Adam Blevins began working in the entertainment industry in 2022 as a Staff Writer for Agents of Fandom, where he progressed to Senior Editor and interviewed talent from Marvel Studios, House of the Dragon, and Planet of the Apes. He joined Collider as a News Author in April 2024, was promoted to a Senior position in December 2024, and has written over 3,000 articles for the site, including exclusives relating to Avengers: Doomsday, The Penguin, Star Wars: Skeleton Crew, and more. He primarily writes about the latest box office numbers and the hottest movies and TV shows on streaming, while also covering superhero and sci-fi news. He has completed a set visit for The Chosen and even has several months of experience writing Gaming Features at ScreenRant. You can find him on X, LinkedIn, and Muckrack.

2026 has been an exciting year for video games, even if the biggest release of them all isn’t coming out for another two months. We’re talking, of course, about Grand Theft Auto 6, the new game from Rockstar that’s set to launch around the world on November 19. There have already been a few big releases this year, like 007 First Light, the new James Bond video game developed by IO Interactive, the same studio that delivered the critically acclaimed Hitman trilogy. Earlier this month, fans were taken aback by the success of The Blood of the Dawnwalker, the new game from rookie studio Rebel Wolves. The studio was founded by the former game director of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, and the similarities between the two games are hard to miss.

While The Blood of the Dawnwalker has been a massive success to the tune of over one million copies sold, the biggest game of September has undoubtedly been Marvel’s Wolverine, hailing from developer Insomniac. The game hasn’t been without its controversy, though. While Insomniac’s first three Spider-Man games have been widely loved by fans and critics, both have taken to picking apart the game with nitpicks like the scent trail, despite heightened senses being one of Logan’s signature traits. After a few social media clips went viral in the days leading up to Wolverine’s release, Insomniac released a new patch over the weekend that significantly dulls the scent trail, making it much less obvious. Some fans have pushed back against it ever being a problem, highlighting that it’s in the game for only around 30 minutes — the story takes between 16 and 18 hours to finish.

Collider Exclusive · 8 Questions · 2 Minutes
Which MCU Character Is Your Best Friend?
Steve Rogers · Tony Stark · Peter Parker · Shuri

Pick where you meet, what they text you at two in the morning, what they hand you on your birthday and what the two of you keep arguing about. Four very different people are waiting on the other side: the one who never leaves, the one who is exhausting and worth it, the one who replies in four seconds flat, and the one who will roast you and then fix your life.
🛡️Steve Rogers(Captain America)
🛠️Tony Stark(Iron Man)
🕸️Peter Parker(Spider-Man)
🐆Shuri(Black Panther)
FIND YOUR FRIEND →

Where do the two of you meet?
Nobody in this universe makes a friend somewhere normal.

AIn a gym at six in the morning, where the two of you are the only people awake.
BAt a party you were not really invited to, where they talked to you for an hour.
CQueuing for coffee in Queens while something loud happens six blocks away.
DIn a lab you had no clearance for, and they decided to let you stay.
NEXT QUESTION →

Your phone lights up at two in the morning. What does it say?
You find out what kind of friend somebody is by what they send at that hour.

ANothing at all, because they are already outside, having heard you had a rough week.
BFour hundred words about an idea they just had, plus a schematic you cannot read.
CAn apology for texting so late, followed by a question that could have waited.
DA meme aimed directly at you, sent with no context and absolutely no mercy.
NEXT QUESTION →

It is your birthday. What do they hand you?
The present is never really about the present.

ASomething small they made themselves, handed over slightly awkwardly.
BSomething absurd and expensive that fixes a problem you mentioned once, months ago.
CA gift that clearly took months of saving, wrapped badly, with a long note inside.
DAn upgrade to something you already owned, installed without asking you first.
NEXT QUESTION →

What does a good Saturday with them actually look like?
Superheroes have days off, and this is how they spend them.

AA long walk, an old diner and a conversation you had both been avoiding.
BWhatever they decide at noon, which somehow ends with you in another country.
CBad takeaway and an old film on their couch, interrupted about eleven times.
DTwo hours in a workshop, arguing about whether your idea would even work.
NEXT QUESTION →

You have your worst day in years. What do they do about it?
This is the part of a friendship nobody puts in the trailer.

AThey sit next to you and say almost nothing until you are ready to talk.
BThey throw money, noise and three terrible plans at it until one of them helps.
CThey turn up with food, refuse to leave, and then check on you every day for a month.
DThey tell you the honest version of it, which nobody else was willing to say.
NEXT QUESTION →

Every real friendship has one fight it keeps having. What is yours?
The thing you argue about is usually the thing you like most about them.

AThey take risks with their own life that they would never let me take with mine.
BThey vanish into work for weeks and expect me to be completely fine about it.
CThey keep apologising for things that were never even slightly their fault.
DThey are three steps ahead of me and do not always bother explaining why.
NEXT QUESTION →

The alarm goes off and you are both in the field. What is your job?
You get one role on the team, and it says a lot about who you want next to you.

AHolding the front line so that everybody behind me gets out of the building.
BDoing the thing nobody has a plan for yet, at speed, and inventing the rest.
CGetting people off the street quietly before anyone realises we were there.
DRunning everything from a screen and talking the rest of them through it.
NEXT QUESTION →

Ten years on, what do you want this friendship to be?
Eight questions in, this is the one that decides who picks up the phone.

AExactly the same, because some people are simply permanent and that is the appeal.
BLoud and complicated and worth every bit of the trouble it caused along the way.
CStill the person I look out for, and still the first one who checks on me.
DTwo people who keep each other sharp and never once get sentimental about it.
https://static0.colliderimages.com/wordpress%2Fwp-content%2Fauthors%2F67769a633ff6a-collider-profile-picture-adam-blevins-1.jpg?fit=crop&w=90&h=90
REVEAL MY BEST FRIEND →

The Line Is Ringing
Your Best Friend Is…

Four people, four completely different ideas of what it means to have
somebody in your corner. Here is who picked up, what they would ask of you, and what you would get
back.
Captain America · Marvel Studios · Since 2011
Steve Rogers

You want the friend who does not leave. Steve is the one who
turns up at the door without being asked, who remembers what you said you were worried
about, and who has never once made you audition for his attention.

His entire character is built on a single sentence, which is that he will not abandon
somebody just because it has become expensive to keep them.

He is far funnier than people give him credit for, and the joke is almost always at his
own expense rather than yours.

The friendship comes with a cost, since being close to Steve means being dragged into
fights that were never yours and being glad about it later.

You would get a friend who tells you the hard thing to your face and then defends you to
everybody else in the room.
Iron Man · Marvel Studios · Since 2008
Tony Stark

You want the friend who is genuinely exhausting and completely
worth it. Tony will forget your birthday, then build you something at four in the morning
that you did not know you needed, and hand it over as though it were nothing.

He is bad at saying the warm thing out loud, so he says it in hardware instead, which is
why everybody around him ends up with upgraded everything.

Being his friend means putting up with the disappearing, the deflecting and the jokes
that arrive about ninety seconds too early.

What you get in return is somebody who will spend an unreasonable amount of money and
effort on a problem the moment it becomes yours.

He is the loudest person in the room and the one most likely to be quietly panicking
about all of you.
Spider-Man · Marvel Studios · Since 2016
Peter Parker

You want the friend who replies in four seconds and apologises
for it. Peter is earnest in a way that is almost unfashionable, and he will take on far more
than he can carry rather than admit that he is struggling.

He is the only one on this list who needs looking after as much as he looks after you,
and that balance is exactly what makes it a real friendship.

Nobody in the MCU is better at the small stuff, from remembering the thing you were
nervous about to showing up with food you did not ask for.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day arrived in July 2026 and put him back where he works best,
which is broke, local and carrying the weight on his own.

You would get a friend who is sincerely, embarrassingly happy for you when something
goes right, with no edge to it at all.
Black Panther · Marvel Studios · Since 2018
Shuri

You want the friend who insults your shoes, fixes your phone and
then quietly rearranges your entire life for the better. Shuri does not do soft reassurance,
and that is the reason you would believe her when she says you are fine.

She is the smartest person in almost any room she walks into and treats that as a reason
to tease you rather than a reason to lecture you.

The teasing is the affection. When Shuri stops making fun of you, something has gone
seriously wrong and you should probably ask her about it.

Her story is the one on this list that goes somewhere genuinely dark, which is what
turned her from a scene stealer into the emotional centre of the films.

You would get a friend who never pities you, never softens the truth, and never once
lets you take yourself too seriously.
↻ RETAKE THE QUIZ
‘Marvel’s Wolverine’ Is No Normal X-Men Story

Marvel’s Wolverine was already fighting against blowback when it was announced a few months before the game that it would be set in a world where the X-Men don’t exist. Logan does work with other iconic mutants like Jean Grey and Mystique to save young mutants, and he even clashes with his brother, Sabertooth, in one of the more visceral boss fights in the entire game. The main villain of the game starts as a companion, though, in Nathaniel Essex. Logan works with Essex to save young mutants, but his ambition takes him too far, leading him to evolve into the iconic cloning X-Men villain, Mister Sinister.
